name: Wuxi Jinyang Precision Manufacturing Co., Ltd.
summary: Wuxi Jinyang Precision Manufacturing Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of battery precision structural parts and materials in China. The company offers steel cases for cylindrical batteries, cylindrical lithium caps, aluminum shell for square power lithium batteries, and square lithium battery covers; and battery packaging shells, safety valves, and nickel-based conductor materials. It also exports its products. The company serves lithium battery manufacturers.
